evidence: Workbook Quality Checks row 39 (check 38) requires every scored prompt to score each criterion on its own and continue after failure; the Internal Quality Checks row agrees. Frozen functional, polish, and visual prompt.md:1 each says 'Continue after ordinary failures and score every row independently' and 'A prior row's failure must not automatically erase independent evidence'; each requests a result for every criterion. Functional prompt.md:5 adds 'keep each criterion independent' and treats a whole-judge/tool failure as an evidence gap rather than product-wide failure. The three judge.toml files each set mode='batched' and scoring.aggregation='weighted_mean'; none instructs stop-on-first-failure. Counterfactual: an editor with broken multi-caret typing but working Find/Replace should retain the latter's credit, and a conforming editor should not lose other rows because one setup or tool step fails; the prompt wording preserves those distinctions. All six scored prompt/judge SHA256 values match the frozen manifest. No actual judge run was supplied or performed, so this verdict covers wording, not observed judge compliance.
